title: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze
start: Inspect Sir Amik Varze in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.
prereq_quests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

items.t: Empty pot (can be obtained during quest, bought from chest or picked from the table in the kitchen)
Radimus notes if you haven't completed Legends' Quest
Dramen staff or Lunar staff if you haven't completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
Raw chicken (can be obtained during the quest at the Chicken Shrine)
Dramen branch (or cinnamon, made from a Dramen branch)

kills.t: Evil Chicken (levels vary around 70, depending on player's level)

rewards.t: Access to the Evil Chicken's Lair, where you can fight black dragons
Further access to the Culinaromancer's chest

steps.t: Inspect Sir Amik Varze.
Talk to the Cook in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen. [Chat: 4 More... › 5 More... › 2 Protecting Sir Amik Varze]
Use a bucket of milk with a pot of cream.
Locate a windmill (Taverley windmill doesn't work) and pick up an empty pot on the floor 1 .
Put sweetcorn into the hopper on the floor 3.
Operate the hopper controls, then take from the flour bin on the floor 1.
Use the milky mixture with the pot of cornflour.
Go to the Kharazi Jungle.

sub.t: Have Radimus notes with you, if Legends' Quest isn't completed.

steps.t: Head southwest of the pool to the beach to find five vanilla plants.
Search a Vanilla plant and add the vanilla pod to the cornflour mixture for brulee.
Go to Draynor Village and talk to the Wise Old Man. [Chat: 3/4 I'd just like to ask you something. › 2 Strange beasts › 4 The Evil Chicken › 2 Thanks, maybe some other time.]
Head to Zanaris. Use a raw chicken on the Chicken shrine. (Kill a chicken near the shrine for a raw chicken if you need one).
Head north and kill the Evil Chicken.

sub.t: If the chicken is not in the shrine, talk to the Cook and attempt to fight it again.

steps.t: Take the evil chicken's egg (right-click the loot pile, as area loot won't show it).
Head south and kill a black dragon.
Take the dragon token it drops (right-click the loot pile, as area loot won't show it).
Use the egg on the brulee.
Craft your dramen branches branch, selecting pestle and mortar.

sub.t: If you do not have Dramen branches, cut one from the dramen tree in the Entrana Dungeon.

steps.t: Add the cinnamon to the brulee.
Wear the ice gloves or dragonfire protection, otherwise you can take up to 500 damage if you don't have them on for the next few steps.
Rub the dragon token in either Lumbridge or Zanaris.
Ask the Fairy Dragon to flambé the brulee. [Chat: 1 Please flambe this creme brulee for me.]
p: A player getting their brulee flambeed.

steps.t: Head back to Lumbridge Castle then use brulee supreme on Sir Amik.
Subquest complete!

p: A player fighting the Evil Chicken.
